bank_statements:
CREATE INDEX idx_bank_statement_imports_profile
    ON bank_statement_imports(profile_id, imported_at)

CREATE INDEX idx_bank_statement_line_decisions_profile
    ON bank_statement_line_decisions(profile_id, state)

CREATE INDEX idx_bank_statement_lines_group
    ON bank_statement_lines(profile_id, dedupe_group)

CREATE INDEX idx_bank_statement_lines_profile_date
    ON bank_statement_lines(profile_id, booking_date)

CREATE TABLE bank_statement_imports (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    profile_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    document_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES external_documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    attachment_id TEXT REFERENCES attachments(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    source_format TEXT NOT NULL,
    file_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    file_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_keys TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_id TEXT,
    account_masked TEXT,
    bank_name TEXT,
    bank_bic TEXT,
    statement_ref TEXT,
    column_map_json TEXT,
    period_start TEXT,
    period_end TEXT,
    lines_total INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    lines_new INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    lines_existing INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    lines_skipped INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    imported_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE bank_statement_line_decisions (
    line_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_statement_lines(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    profile_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('accepted', 'rejected')),
    source_id TEXT REFERENCES source_funds_sources(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    group_key TEXT,
    reasons_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (line_id, transaction_id)
)

CREATE TABLE bank_statement_lines (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    profile_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    import_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_statement_imports(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    document_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES external_documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    line_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    booking_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    value_date TEXT,
    amount TEXT NOT NULL,
    currency TEXT NOT NULL,
    counterparty_name TEXT,
    counterparty_iban_masked TEXT,
    remittance TEXT,
    bank_reference TEXT,
    end_to_end_id TEXT,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_masked TEXT,
    dedupe_group TEXT NOT NULL,
    dedupe_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (profile_id, dedupe_key)
)
provider_trade_holds:
CREATE INDEX idx_provider_trade_holds_profile
    ON provider_trade_holds(profile_id, state)

CREATE TABLE provider_trade_holds (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    profile_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    provider TEXT NOT NULL,
    trade_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    trade_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('held', 'cleared')),
    txids_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    cleared_reason TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (profile_id, provider, trade_id)
)
